retrieved.text:
Return policy
Customers may return unused items within thirty days of purchase. A receipt is required. Final-sale products cannot be returned. Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within seven business days after inspection.

Delivery policy
Standard delivery takes five business days and costs five dollars. Express delivery takes two business days and costs twelve dollars. The original delivery charge is not refunded when a customer returns an unwanted item.

Product warranty
Electronics have a twelve-month warranty covering manufacturing defects. Accidental damage and water damage are excluded. Warranty claims require proof of purchase. Clothing does not have an electronics warranty.

Product care
Wash cotton clothing in cold water and dry it on a low setting. Store electronics in a dry location away from direct sunlight. Disconnect devices before cleaning them with a soft cloth.
